import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_38/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_38/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN on "city"
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="city", how="inner")

# Operation 2: group_by on Source2_38_0.type and aggregation sum(Source2_38_1.fare)
result = df_joined.groupby("type", as_index=False)["fare"].sum()

# Ensure the column types match the target schema: 'type' as string, 'fare' as float
result["type"] = result["type"].astype(str)
result["fare"] = result["fare"].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_38/target_multisource.csv"
result.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_38/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_38/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on city column (inner join by default)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="city")

# Group by 'type' and sum the 'fare' column
result = joined.groupby("type", as_index=False).agg({"fare": "sum"})

# Write output with exact target schema and column names
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_38/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
